name: Teddy's Tees Inc
old_description: Teddy's Tees specializes in custom screen printing services, allowing us to print large batches of a single design quickly and consistently. Screen printing uses stencils and fabric paint to complete a design, and is one of the oldest methods used in apparel. Simple designs with only a few colors are typically used on screen printed items. We are happy to talk with you about the best design principles for screen printing, and how it can be more cost effective than other methods.
about:
Teddy's Tees operates in Concord, New Hampshire, at 248 Sheep Davis Road. The company provides screen printing, embroidery, and custom graphic tee services to the surrounding area.

The shop specializes in custom screen printing using stencils and fabric paint, a method suited for large batches of simple designs with few colors. It also offers embroidery for professional apparel and works with clients to select printing techniques. The facility's capacity is described as handling large batches quickly and consistently, though specific headcount or floor space is not disclosed.

Teddy's Tees serves local businesses and event organizers needing branded apparel, promotional items, and team wear. Its in-house graphic artists assist with logo reproduction and custom branding projects.

The company emphasizes years of experience, up-to-date techniques, and clear communication throughout the order process as factors that set its service apart.
